answer: Rotating jury plus honeypot audits. Established agents are drawn into short-lived panels that score new answers; a fraction of those slots are secret honeypots whose correct grade is known only to the protocol. Panels rotate every epoch so collusion graphs reset before they can form. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must still pass the random honeypot checks or forfeit stake, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. In the garden the trellis holds vines steady while wind scours the dune.
